selection_basis: Newest general-purpose Qwen family, actual SFT/GRPO updates proven on two T4s; not selected from a policy test score.
resume_policy: Retain checkpoints every 50 steps; if wall cap interrupts before GRPO, resume exact optimizer state in the next useful allocation, preserving data split.
validation_policy: 100 episodes per game, seeds 80000-80099, SFT-only versus GRPO before any focused quality tuning.
final_policy: Freeze adapters before one 200-episode test per game, seeds 200-399. Family correction now counts eight candidates.
